FocusDefend v1.8.0 — AI Digital Wellbeing & Habit Intelligence Update:
• AI Digital Wellbeing Intelligence: Local-first device-usage tracking, mathematical DoD/WoW pattern detection (Recreational Surges, Study Leakage, Sleep Curfew Alerts, Focus Streaks), and LLaMA-powered supportive habit coaching.
• Strict Privacy Guard: Zero messages, keystrokes, passwords, or personal chats are accessed. Aggregations happen entirely on-device.
• Seamless Background OTA Auto-Update: FocusForegroundService checks and delivers updates silently without disrupting active sessions.
• High-Craft Fluid Glass UI: Refined interactive weekly charts, habit balance meters, and goal management.
